facts.fact: Atlancis, EverseTech and iXAfrica launched Servernah Cloud, described as Kenya's first sovereign-hosted cloud and AI platform, with locally available GPU capacity for AI inference and model deployment, at iXAfrica's Nairobi facility.
iXAfrica's CEO Snehar Shah said the AI infrastructure deployment is 'now live for the market', and EverseTech demonstrated locally available GPU capacity at the 22.5 MW Nairobi data centre.

systems.platform: Atlancis Servernah cloud with EverseTech AI-as-a-Service

facts.fact: iXAfrica describes its 22.5 MW Nairobi facility on Mombasa Road as a hyperscale, carrier-neutral, AI-ready data centre hosting the Servernah Cloud launch.

KEN.note: Describes a sovereign-hosted private cloud; no government data, rule or contract term is stated.
Ownership of the iXAfrica data centre is not stated.
